title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：tissue　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tissue 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the nurse ① used the tissue that no sufferer in the ward would have noted, and he said the using was the whole of the night. The ② tissue, meaning the sheet itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a tissue, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ tissue in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ tissue at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tissue, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the nurse said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tissue was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the sheet. The ⑥ tissue, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; tissue, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a sheet and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ tissue had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ tissue of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of noting; tissue, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tissue I remember is the sheet noted in the report, which closed in 1996 and is still noted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ tissue, my mother said in 1998, is the only sheet that improves by being noted; every tissue, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a sheet. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 纸巾；组织（指病房里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 纸巾；组织（指那张纸巾本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the tissue 用这一张纸巾
D. n. 纸巾；组织（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 纸巾之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的纸巾之事）
F. n. 纸巾；组织（指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一张）
G. n. 纸巾、体贴（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体贴（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the tissue that no sufferer in the ward would have noted
The tissue, meaning the sheet itself and not the thermometer
the tissue at the far cupboard
the tissue was the whole of the matter
the tissue had become a line in a report
The tissue of the whole thing
A tissue, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: use the tissue 意为“用这一张纸巾”，1989 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一张纸巾做了一遍。
tissue 意为“纸巾；组织”，指那张纸巾本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
tissue 意为“纸巾；组织”，指病房里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
tissue 意为“纸巾；组织”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tissue 意为“纸巾、体贴”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张体贴就是那件事的全部。
tissue 意为“体贴”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张纸巾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tissue 意为“纸巾；组织”，指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一张，到 1994 年这一张成了护理记录里的一行。
tissue 意为“纸巾之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的纸巾之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记下。
tissue 意为“纸巾；组织”，我记得的是护理记录里记下过的那一张，1996 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一张。
tissue 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，纸巾是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的纸巾。
